open_leads.title: CVE-2026-131914 Idunno.AntiCsrf: write analysis from Mandiant MNDT-2026-0048
open_leads.note: Retry when the advisory can be read (through GitHub access or a later run), or when CISA KEV or NVD publish an entry. The Hacker News, quoting Mandiant, reports the following. It is an unauthenticated insecure deserialization flaw in AntiCsrfModule (unkeyed ObjectStateFormatter, no MAC) that gives code execution as w3wp.exe, CVSS 9.3. Active exploitation was observed and no patch exists. Mandiant advises replacing the library with a supported anti-CSRF mechanism (for example System.Web.Helpers.AntiForgery, or ViewStateUserKey with MAC-verified ViewState), auditing Web.config and bin/ for references to it, and reviewing IIS logs for anomalous POSTs to .aspx endpoints that returned 302 or 500 with large cs-bytes. If compromise is found, rotate the machineKey and other secrets in Web.config and applicationHost.config. All of this needs confirming against the advisory.
